title: Lesson 7 - Turning sales KPIs into reports: report types, filters, and the Lightning report builder
description: Identify ways to transform business outcomes and sales KPIs into reports and dashboards.

questions.question: You need one report that compares open pipeline and closed-won blocks built from different report types. Which report format do you use?
questions.explanation: A joined report combines blocks from different report types into one layout, which Tabular and the grouped formats cannot do.

questions.question: A sales leader asks for win rate by quarter, but the report currently just counts closed-won opportunities. What do you add?
options: A summary formula on the summary report
questions.explanation: Win rate is a ratio, so it needs a summary formula over the grouped rows rather than a raw count.

questions.question: Every viewer must see the same company-wide pipeline number regardless of their own record access. Which dashboard setting achieves this?
options: Run as another user (a specific user)
questions.explanation: Running the dashboard as one specific user shows that user's data scope to every viewer, while dynamic dashboards show each viewer their own scope.
